title: Grey In Grey Pt. I - High Hopes
author: CrankerMan

title.en: Grey In Grey Sci-Fi Plot Build

generated.description: A tall, monochrome sci-fi structure built mostly from dirt, stone, stone bricks, and gray and black stained glass, with glowstone and iron bars for accents. It rises about 99 blocks high on a 51 by 51 footprint, with a stepped, tower-like core and a wide base. The source gives no description of its interior, so none is claimed here.
